purpose: Refresh GW004 Results vs Match Report alignment after new Match Report imports
sql: SELECT k.competition_key,COALESCE(r.n,0) results,COALESCE(m.n,0) match_reports,COALESCE(x.same_key,0) fixture_same_key,COALESCE(x.diff_key,0) fixture_different_key,COALESCE(r.n,0)-COALESCE(x.any_match,0) results_without_report,COALESCE(m.n,0)-COALESCE(y.any_match,0) reports_without_result FROM (SELECT competition_key FROM `GW004_IMC Results` UNION SELECT competition_key FROM `GW004_IMC Match Report`) k LEFT JOIN (SELECT competition_key,COUNT(*) n FROM `GW004_IMC Results` GROUP BY competition_key) r ON r.competition_key=k.competition_key LEFT JOIN (SELECT competition_key,COUNT(*) n FROM `GW004_IMC Match Report` GROUP BY competition_key) m ON m.competition_key=k.competition_key LEFT JOIN (SELECT r.competition_key,COUNT(m.sm_fixture_id) any_match,SUM(CASE WHEN m.sm_fixture_id IS NOT NULL AND m.competition_key=r.competition_key THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) same_key,SUM(CASE WHEN m.sm_fixture_id IS NOT NULL AND m.competition_key<>r.competition_key THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) diff_key FROM `GW004_IMC Results` r LEFT JOIN `GW004_IMC Match Report` m ON m.sm_fixture_id=r.sm_fixture_id GROUP BY r.competition_key) x ON x.competition_key=k.competition_key LEFT JOIN (SELECT m.competition_key,COUNT(r.sm_fixture_id) any_match FROM `GW004_IMC Match Report` m LEFT JOIN `GW004_IMC Results` r ON r.sm_fixture_id=m.sm_fixture_id GROUP BY m.competition_key) y ON y.competition_key=k.competition_key ORDER BY k.competition_key
